entities.summary: Jan Ejnar Jørgensen is a Danish politician, who is was a member of the Folketing for 15 years. A member of the political party Venstre, Jørgensen has been a member of the Danish parliment for 15 years; he was elected in the 2011 Danish general election and stayed a member until the election in 2026 where he did not get reelected.
